# Narrative Axis v2 diagnostic

Canonical luto infantil proof passed technically but the v2 Axis still made an unsupported ranking upgrade: `é o que, paradoxalmente, mais a impede de elaborar a perda`.

Persisted editorial understanding supports that concealment/euphemisms are harmful and can complicate grief, but does not rank this as the greatest obstacle among all factors. Therefore the overclaim is introduced in Narrative Axis proposal, not inherited from the understanding.
